text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- U.S. seeks extradition of a Maltese man. The Maltese Magistrates' Court has been formally requested to look into the request and decide whether there are grounds for the exradition of Tony Satariono, who, the US alleges, was involved in a plot to defraud a Michigan savings bank of property and cash worth $700,000.
- Prime Minister Alfred Sant told parliament the police force was being restructured to more effectively tackle drug abuse and trafficking.
